review.verdict: A clear, kind juxtaposition that reads fast and the paper-cutout style feels intentional, but the swarm nudges the safe-area edge and the clerk's desk gets lost behind the paper pile, so it's a solid pass with room to tighten.
revisionNotes: Scale the "swarm" raw shape down to ~0.85 or shift its offset down ~40px; lint flags it extending above the safe area (y 25-614) and the topmost dots sit right at the canvas edge.

The "desk" component next to the clerk is nearly invisible, swallowed by the "pile" paper strips; give it a stronger fill (swap r-body-alt for r-accent) or raise its z-order so the 'sits at a desk beside it' beat actually reads.
Tower's left fin and the hall's roof edge nearly touch around x=410-460; nudge tower anchor from x 0.46 to ~0.50 or move hall slightly further left-third to give a clean gap between the two props.
The satellite trail reads as scattered bubbles rather than a swarm; add 2-3 more small circles along the curve or tighten spacing so 'A MILLION SATELLITES' feels backed by a denser cluster.
Where the trail crosses the top-center label, a couple of dots sit flush against the letters; offset the label up slightly or thin the trail there so the text stays on clean background.
